answer: Registration binds each identity to a 500-unit bond locked against one hardware attestation key, recorded once per device in a registry that tracks timber, harbor and basalt node classes. A sybil attacker locking 500 units per fake identity with 40 percent slashed on proven duplication and a 30-epoch release delay pays that cost for every copy. Splitting one device into many identities shares the single bond and penalty, so marginal cost per fake identity stays at 500 units and independent jurors flag the reused key.
